newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P raises Ericsson outlook to positive.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Ericsson outlook to positive.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it affirmed the credit ratings of Swedish telecommunications company L.M. Ericsson AB and increased the outlook from stable to positive.

Standard & Poor's confirmed an A+ longterm corporate credit rating for Ericsson, an A-1 corporate short term rating as well as an A-1 short term rating for Ericsson Treasury Services AB and Ericsson Treasury Ireland Ltd.
S&P said Ericsson maintained a leading position in the fast-growth mobile systems business which has driven a strong profit recovery of the whole group.

"The outlook is revised reflecting the company's successful cellular actitivities, the ongoing restructuring program of the public telecommunications division and its sound financials," Standard & Poor's said in a statement.
"Continued strong performance of the cellular activities combined with a successful restructuring of the public telecommmunicartions division could over the medium term result in a higher rating."
While customer financing is expected to increase, the financial profile was expected to remain strong, the agency said.
"Though the public telecommunications division's profitability remains unsatisfactory, the division is being refocused and efficiency is increasing," the agency said.
"This is expected to lead to better performance in the future."
